name: Hershey's Spreads Cocoa with Almond
ingredients: Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Oil), Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids (4.7%), Almond Paste (3%), Hydrogenated Vegetable Fat (Palm Oil & Sesame Oil), Emulsifier (322(i)), Flavours (Artificial Flavouring Substances-Almond and Vanilla) & Edible Common Salt ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS MILK, SOY AND NUT. MAY CONTAIN WHEAT.
